<div class="proj-header">
  <h1>Intra-specific morphological variation</h1>
</div>
<img class="proj-img" src="data/FishPic.png" alt="Intra-specific morphological variation"/>
<div class="proj-body">
<p>The objective of this project is to measure the variation of morphological traits within freshwater fish species and to understand the drivers of such variability across species. This work bridges individual-level phenotypic variation and macroecological patterns of functional diversity.</p>
<p>This project is supported by <strong>Pierre Bertrand</strong> (Master Student, CRBE) and funded by <em>CEBA</em> — details available <a href="https://www.labex-ceba.fr/assets/projets-annuels-2025" target="_blank">here</a> — and <em>TREMPLIN</em> — details <a href="https://www.labex-ceba.fr/assets/projets-annuels-2025" target="_blank">here</a>.</p>
</div>
